name: Military Facility Tycoon 2
desc:
🎖️ Military Facility Tycoon 2 is a remastered game where you can become the Lead Director of one of the six facilities. Upgrade your base to become better protected from break-ins, or to easily infiltrate other bases. Launch the nuke, and then survive it in Site 02 to earn cash. Rob the oil rig and buy new weapons at the beach shop! # MFT2, MFT

For a complete list of updates and rebirth info, visit this post: 
🔹 https://devforum.roblox.com/t/2135109

Give the game a THUMBS UP👍 if you enjoy it! Join our group for 15k cash!
